extracted.name: Black Sesame Chocolate Cookies
extracted.description: Toasted black sesame seeds and chocolate really make a unique flavor combo. It's toasty, nutty, and chocolatey. 😋 The cookie is soft in the center but crispy and chewy around the edges.
ingredient_lines: 113 g (1/2 cup) unsalted butter, room temperature
30 g (3 tbsp) black sesame seeds, toasted and processed into powder
instruction_lines: Beat butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until light fluffy.
Add egg and mix briefly to combine.
Sieve in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the toasted black sesame powder. Mix again until 80% combined.
Add chocolate chips and mix just until combined. Try not to overmix.
(Optional) To develop the flavor, refrigerate the dough for 1 hour or best overnight. After chilled, the dough will also become less sticky and easier to handle.

Using an ice cream scoop or simply a spoon, portion out the dough equally onto a tray lined with parchment paper. I used a large scoop that is equivalent to 3 tablespoons and got 12 large cookies. The cookies will spread thin in the oven so space them apart. Sprinkle black sesame seeds onto each.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (180°C) for 18-20 minutes. If you portion your cookies smaller, make sure to check earlier because they will bake faster. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
